QUOTE: It is off by default (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:208`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` is off by default at the config line. It never says it is commented out in the shipped header. The only "commented out" remark is about the `CALLOC_MACRO` and `FREE_MACRO` options, not about `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`.
